note: Corps of Engineers campground on a point on the west shore of Tuttle Creek Lake, 3 miles up Tuttle Cove Road from K-13 at the west end of the dam: two loops of gravel back-ins, the northern one curving along the riprap shore. The walk from the sites to the shower buildings is steep. --Claude
summary: rec.gov 234280: 39 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC back-ins, 50 A + water on all (live attribute and RIDB agree; 50 A stands), $26 (was 24), season 04-15..10-31, 14 nights per rolling 30, showers/flush/vault/dump. max_rig 140 cleared (driveways 20-90 ft). Waterfront down lakefront -> lakeview (loop road between pads and shore; 010/011 unsure). Pin on the centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' (evidence 'satellite at 39.2808,-96.6315: ... RV pads directly along the shoreline on the point') -> 'lakeview'. TP loop 023-039 curves along the north-east shore but the loop road runs between every pad and the riprap bank (pads point inward off the road), so lakeview under the loop-road rule; LS 001-009 sit behind their road and a tree strip ~60-80 m from the shore, lakeview at best; 012-022 back onto woods. Only 010 and 011, at the end of the LS spur road, have open grass with no road to the bank (~25-40 m to the riprap), but the leaf-off frame shows a shadowed steep bank and the DEM drops from 345 m at 011 to 328 m at the water, so it reads as a bench above a climb-down; unsure, so lakeview. A firsthand look at 010/011 could earn lakefront.
FEES: $24 -> $26. The rates table now lists only $26 for the 2026-2028 Peak Seasons; every site prices $26 on the campsite search.

HOOKUPS: 50 A confirmed - live rec.gov 'Electric Hookup' 50 on all 39 bookable sites, RIDB cache the same, and the facility text says '39 sites offer water and 50 amp electric hookups'. No management/host records in the catalog.
SITES: max_rig_ft 140 cleared (it came from note prose and is site 011's posted equipment length; its driveway is 90 ft). pull_through false: every site 'Back-In'. Count 39 stands.
FIT: most sites take 58-90 ft, but recreation.gov caps RVs at 25 ft on 023, 033 and 034 and at 20 ft on 035 (unlevel sites), and 022's trailer cap is 20 ft; plenty of others fit EKKO.
PHONE 785-539-6523 confirmed (rec.gov facility phone and Google). Website rec.gov page stands.
DISCOUNTS: rec.gov carries a 'militaryDiscount' rule value; not a discount claim, nothing written.
